title: Arrow's impossibility theorem (general finite version)
abstract: Formalizes Arrow's impossibility theorem for finitely many voters and finitely many alternatives (at least three): every social welfare function satisfying unanimity and independence of irrelevant alternatives is dictatorial. The proof follows the classical decisive-coalition argument: field expansion (a coalition decisive for one pair is decisive for every pair) and group contraction (a decisive coalition with at least two voters contains a smaller decisive coalition), iterated down to a singleton dictator. This is a reusable formalization artifact, not a claim of new mathematics.
